title: NK6505 VIP Corn (NK6505 Viptera): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK6505 VIP Corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK6505 VIP corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. About 107 days to harvest, 6.6 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK6505 VIP corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK6505 Viptera. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2025 as NSIC 2025 GMCn 102. Syngenta Crop Protection AG bred it. It takes about 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.58 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about NK6505 VIP corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK6505 VIP corn takes about 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.58 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 107 days in national trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.5 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 83.07 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** National trials averaged 6.58 t/ha in Mindanao, shelling recovery about 83 percent.
**Traits in the seed:** The VIP trait, sold under Syngenta's Protek Todo banner against fall armyworm and other corn caterpillars. Its page does not list the gene events.
**Where:** Registered for Mindanao, and sold for the highlands of Mindanao.
Plant about 224 cm tall in national trials.
Ear about 16.5 cm long.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on Syngenta's current Philippine corn list as the VIP version of NK6505, under its Protek Todo banner. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant NK6505 VIP corn

It is recommended for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: Is NK6505 Viptera the same as NK6505 VIP?
items.a: Yes. NK6505 Viptera is another name for NK6505 VIP, registered as NSIC 2025 GMCn 102. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 107 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 6.58 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK6505 VIP?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
